def anonymous_target.{u_1} : {E :
    Type u_1} →
  {K : Set E} → ↑K → E → ↑K :=
fun {E} {K} fallback x => if hx : x ∈ K then ⟨x, hx⟩ else fallback

blind_reconstruction.text:
Objects: A function that returns an element of a subset using a chosen fallback when necessary.

Domains: E is an arbitrary type; K is any subset of E; fallback is a member of the subtype K; x is any element of E. Output lies in the subtype K.

Quantifiers: Definition universally parameterized by E,K,then fallback in K,then x in E.

Assumptions: Only the supplied fallback in K is required, so K is inhabited. No topology, metric, measure, or algebraic structure is assumed.

Conclusion: If x belongs to K, return the subtype element consisting of x and its membership proof; otherwise return fallback.

Scopes: The test is pointwise membership. In the first branch the output's ambient value is exactly x; in the other branch it is the ambient value of fallback. This is not asserted to be a metric projection or to have any continuity/measurability property.

Constant dependencies: The result depends only on K,fallback,x (with proof fields carrying subtype membership); no constant or limit is involved.

import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.BorelSpace.Basic

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.CompactStateRepresentative

open Set

variable {E : Type*} {K : Set E}

/-- Keep each point of the set and send points outside it to a fixed member. -/
noncomputable def restrictState (fallback : K) (x : E) : K := by
  classical
  exact
  if hx : x ∈ K then ⟨x, hx⟩ else fallback

theorem coe_restrictState_of_mem (fallback : K) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ K) :
    (restrictState fallback x : E) = x := by
  classical
  simp [restrictState, hx]

theorem measurable_restrictState [MeasurableSpace E]
    (hK : MeasurableSet K) (fallback : K) : Measurable (restrictState fallback) := by
  classical
  apply Measurable.subtype_mk
  have heq : (fun x => (restrictState fallback x : E)) =
      K.piecewise id (fun _ => fallback.val) := by
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ K <;> simp [restrictState, Set.piecewise, hx]
  change Measurable (fun x => (restrictState fallback x : E))
  rw [heq]
  exact measurable_id.piecewise hK measurable_const
end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.CompactStateRepresentative
